home.need_photos: LocalRoll needs access to your photos to send the originals to your PC.
home.limited: You allowed only some photos, so only those can be seen and sent.
connect.title: Connect to PC
connect.scan: Scan the QR code on your PC
connect.searching: Searching… (open LocalRoll on your PC first)
connect.manual: Can't find it? Enter the IP address
connect.address_field: PC address (IP:port shown on the PC's Receive tab)
scan.title: Scan pairing code
scan.hint: Point at the QR code on the PC's LocalRoll Receive tab
scan.not_ours: This is not a LocalRoll pairing code
transfer.title: Send to {name}
transfer.sending: Sending… keep the app open; the screen will stay on.
err.cannot_reach: Can't reach the PC ({error}). Make sure the phone and PC are on the same Wi-Fi, and tap "Allow through firewall" on the PC's Receive tab.
err.pc_not_found: Can't find "{name}". Make sure LocalRoll is open on the PC and both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
err.no_original: Can't read the original (it may be in iCloud and can't be downloaded right now)
err.save_failed: The PC could not save the file
err.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Use the new code shown on the PC.
err.not_paired: This phone is no longer paired with the PC. Please pair again.
err.unknown_session: The transfer session expired. Please send again.
err.no_data: The PC received no data, please send again
scan.camera_error: Camera unavailable ({error}). Allow camera access for LocalRoll in Settings, or use "Enter the IP address" instead.
bg.title: LocalRoll is sending
err.background_expired: iOS paused the background transfer. Open LocalRoll and send again — it continues where it stopped.
transfer.background_ok: You can lock the screen or switch apps — sending continues in the background.
transfer.keep_open: Keep LocalRoll open until sending finishes (background sending needs iOS 26 or later).
cleanup.title: Free up space
cleanup.how: The PC just re-read each file, and its fingerprint matches the original.
cleanup.not_safe: {count} items aren’t on the PC (or have changed) and will stay on your phone.
cleanup.none: Nothing to clean up yet. Send photos to your PC first, then come back here.
cleanup.done_ios: Space freed. Deleted items stay in “Recently Deleted” for 30 days.
pair.same_symbols: The PC shows the same three symbols.
connect.tap_hint: Tap your PC, then click Allow on it.
connect.offline: Not on this Wi-Fi right now
err.pair_expired: Nobody answered on the PC. Try again.
connect.all_paired: All PCs on this Wi-Fi are already paired — they’re listed below.
connect.none_found: No other PC found. Open LocalRoll on the PC and make sure both are on the same Wi-Fi.
cleanup.lost_body: They were backed up before, but have since been deleted or changed on the PC. Your phone has the only copy — they will not be offered for deletion.
auto.enabled: From now on, new photos and videos go to {pc} by themselves.
auto.waiting_hint: The PC is off or not on this Wi-Fi. They’ll be sent automatically when it is.
settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_send_hint: New photos and videos go to {pc} on their own whenever it is reachable.
lost.title: {count} items were deleted on {pc}
lost.body: They are still on this phone, but no longer backed up.
connect.forget_body: This phone removes the pairing, and the PC stops trusting this phone. Photos already on that PC are not affected. To use it again, just tap it and allow.
ios.photos: LocalRoll reads your photos and videos so it can send the originals to your computer.
ios.camera: Scan the pairing QR code shown on your computer.
ios.local_network: Find and connect to computers running LocalRoll on your local network. Files never go through the cloud.
cleanup.icloud: If iCloud Photos is on, deleting here also removes these from iCloud and your other Apple devices. Your copy on {pc} stays.
family.title: Family
family.your_name_hint: Not set — the PC shows this phone's name
family.your_name_explain: Phones with the same name count as one person on the PC, e.g. “Anna 1”, “Anna 2”.
family.default_visibility: Photos I send can be seen by:
family.visibility_hint: “Only me” hides photos from other family members in LocalRoll. They are still ordinary files on the PC: anyone who can sign in to that PC can open the folder.
family.now_private: {count} items are now visible only to you
family.now_shared: {count} items are now visible to the family
family.visibility_failed: Couldn't reach {pc}. Try again when it's on.
simple.title: Simple mode
simple.hint: Big text and one big button — good for parents and grandparents. New photos are sent automatically.
simple.no_pc: Not connected to a computer yet
err.phone_space_size: Not enough free space on the phone for this {size} file. Free up some space, then send it again.
err.phone_space: The phone is out of free space. Free up some space, then send it again.
home.backup_all_body: A big library can take a few hours. Keep the phone plugged in and on Wi-Fi. If it stops, it picks up where it left off.
transfer.long_tip: Big backup: keep the phone plugged in and on Wi-Fi. If it stops, it picks up where it left off.
transfer.no_space_summary: {count} files were not sent because the phone ran out of free space. Free up some space (for example, delete photos that are already safely on the PC), then send them again.
err.library_offline: The PC's photo library folder can't be reached right now (external drive unplugged?). Nothing was lost — try again when it's back.
transfer.stop_body: The {done} items already sent are safely on {pc}. The rest stay on your phone and continue next time — the file in progress resumes where it stopped.
